We are trying to capture small intraday edges via tight profit targets and stops, using volume filters to avoid chop. The edge may exist due to short-term mean reversion in SPY 0DTE options, but the negative J-edge capture suggests misalignment with the source-of-truth trades.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Triggered when volume ratio exceeds 1.2 (vol_ratio_threshold) and other shotgun_scalper conditions (unspecified in combo). Strike: ITM-2 put (strike_offset=2).  
**Exit:** 
- Take profit at 50% premium gain (tp_premium_pct=0.5)
